findings.evidence: Confirmed declarations: `iSup_weightSpace_eq_top_of_basis` (77), `repr_eq_zero_of_mem_weightSpace_of_basis` (101), `weightSpace_eq_span_of_basis` (113), `weightSpace_eq_bot_of_basis` (133), `weightSpace_ne_bot_iff_of_basis` (144), `isInternal_weightSpace_of_basis` (165), and `finrank_weightSpace_eq_one_of_basis` (172), each beginning `(b : Module.Basis ι k W)`; adjacent library files such as `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Basis/RangeSpan.lean:19` place such methods in `namespace Module.Basis`.
findings.fix: Move lines 77, 101, 113, 133, 144, 165, and 172 to `namespace Module.Basis`, remove the redundant `_of_basis` suffixes as appropriate, and update consumers to use `b.theoremName`.
findings.issue: All seven generic theorems are in `TauCeti`, although their first explicit argument is the existing Mathlib type `Module.Basis`; the namespace rule requires basis methods to live in `Module.Basis`.

summary: The reusable basis-driven API is placed in the wrong namespace, preventing conventional dot notation.
